facts.business: PVP Ventures Limited is an Indian listed company that acquires equity interests in entities classified as subsidiaries and associates, with investments carried at cost in standalone financial statements.
key_risks: Significant judgment involved in assessment of control over acquired subsidiaries
Delays in submission of financial results to stock exchanges leading to fines from NSE and BSE
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations regarding board meeting quorum and timely filing
Differences between consolidated balance sheet figures under Regulation 33 and the Act due to recasting/reclassification
facts.related_party_note: For acquisitions from related parties, performed procedures in accordance with SA 550 - Related Parties, including tracing the consideration to the underlying agreements and Board/committee approvals and evaluating whether the transactions were appropriately identified, authorized and disclosed.
